hypotheses.purpose: Characterize how changing ONLY the validation-derived calibrated-P10 veto percentile affects pass counts, full Top-K filling and past cohort decision metrics.
hypotheses.alternative_rules: q=0.15 and q=0.35; never promote or re-optimize a rule based on historic V2/V3/V4 outcomes

threshold_spec.cutoffs_from: Original 19880-row V0 VALID subset; same P10 predictor, original calibration and per-news weighting.
threshold_spec.quantile_method: numpy argsort ascending float values; cumulative legacy_news_weights; first cumulative >= q*sum_weights via searchsorted(side=left), using original dtype/no interpolated midpoint
threshold_spec.validation_weights: legacy_news_weights(news_ids_within_original_validation_subset) with each original news ID total weight 1

selection.baseline: Freeze V0 ex-ante ranker predictions at original selected iteration 10; stable legacy rank tie policy. Top K highest baseline scores.
selection.candidate: Walk exactly the same ordered baseline list; veto rows failing threshold, retaining first K passing; no re-ranking.
selection.K_rule: floor(0.10*N) for each old cohort (V2=444, V3=282, V4=4032)
selection.zero_fill_or_insufficient_count: INFEASIBLE; no lowering cutoff, no smaller effective K, no alternate tuning
selection.news_and_ticker_keys: original canonicalized frozen 40320 V4, 4449 V2, 2827 V3 source row order and news_id keys

uncertainty.on_infeasible_bootstrap: report all failed replicates; if any infeasible for a cell, no resampled interval claim without a separately frozen valid treatment

stop_rules: G2 not frozen means no G3 computations.
Any mismatch to original q25 or original q25 23,348 V4 accepted from stored original signals: stop, audit provenance.
Absence of either prior predicted P10 and baseline scores or old per-row news/ticker target alignment: stop.
Any unavailable outcome file or failed source SHA: report source feasibility and no result.
For each infeasible q/old-cohort cell, show count and INFEASIBLE; no implicit imputation.
Do not choose a best percentile as new approved policy; all old data already observed.
No new independent temporal test, no realized financial P&L, no human causal effect inference.
